fields.title: 📖 The Dīn is naṣīḥah
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Messenger of Allah ﷺ** said:

***“The Dīn is naṣīḥah.”***

**The Ṣaḥābah said:**

***“For whom?”***

**He ﷺ said:**

***“For Allah, for His Book, for His Messenger, for the leaders of the Muslims and for their common people.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:**  
**Naṣīḥah** is not merely advice, but sincere loyalty and honest goodwill: toward Allah, His Book, His Messenger ﷺ, those responsible among the Muslims and the Muslim common people.

immutable.source: 📝 Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim, Kitāb al-Īmān, Bāb Bayān anna ad-Dīn an-Naṣīḥah, Nr. 55. Überliefert von Tamīm ad-Dārī (رضي الله عنه). Ṣaḥīḥ.
